clips.title: The story
paras: In Kharanos, a barrel of Thunder Ale has been taken from the Thunderbrew Distillery. Its place was meant to be taken by Marleth's Barleybrew Scalder, proof of a brewing feud turned to foul play.

The Thunderbrews of Kharanos and the Barleybrews of Brewnall Village are bitter rivals. Marleth Barleybrew tried to slip a barrel of his Barleybrew Scalder into the Thunderbrews' cellar, hoping their patrons would choose his brew. The Thunder Ale barrel was seized in the exchange, evidence that the switch succeeded despite the local guards.
